title: 基于多模态语言模型的社交媒体AI生成内容检测
summary: 提出一种持续收集多模态社交媒体数据并训练紧凑视觉语言模型的管线，用于检测和解释AI生成内容。在公开基准上达到SOTA性能，并在多平台内部数据集上展现出鲁棒检测和解释能力。部署后对用户参与度产生积极影响，证明在动态真实社交环境中进行有效AIGC检测是可行的。
summary_en: We present a pipeline that continuously curates diverse multi-modal social media data and trains a compact vision-language model for detecting and explaining AI-generated content. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on public benchmarks and robust detection on internal datasets across platforms. Deployment for post recommendation shows positive downstream impacts on user engagement, demonstrating feasibility in dynamic real-world environments.
